rule: A twin package must not ship outputs that the package's own code renders (knitted HTML/PDF of a shipped Rmd or qmd, figures written by a shipped script, logs). Those files show the unpatched results, so comparing them with a rerun reveals the planted change. Data the analysis reads are kept even when a shipped script created them, as are author documents (README, codebook, surveys, preregistrations, manuscript copies) and experiment task files.
